  "description": "May Publishing Limited is a research, knowledge management and publishing firm, which has continued to pursue remarkable heights in the production, management and preservation of knowledge, in scholarly and strategic research and publishing, and in the development of high standards in literacy and learning through general interest works. Through its cutting-edge research, professional editorial processes, and unique methods of harnessing and producing audience-compelling narratives, the firm has been assigned world-class projects from top-class individuals, corporate entities, and other states institutions, the depth of which has been attested by readers as appealing, engaging and significant to human, social and corporate development.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Videographer / Video Editor&nbsp;

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Videographer/Video Editor with strong graphics design and motion picture experience to join our team.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, shooting, designing, and editing high-quality visual content that aligns with our brand&rsquo;s vision.
	This role is critical in telling compelling stories, creating promotional and educational content, and supporting marketing, social media, and publication projects.


Key Responsibilities
Pre-Production &amp; Planning:


	Collaborate with content, marketing, and editorial teams to conceptualize video and visual projects.
	Develop scripts, storyboards, and shot lists.
	Design visual elements, layouts, and motion graphics to complement video content.
	Plan shoots, including location scouting, scheduling, and equipment setup.


Production (Videography):


	Capture high-quality video footage using professional equipment.
	Direct video shoots, including lighting, sound, and camera angles.
	Ensure proper framing, composition, and brand consistency.


Post-Production (Video Editing &amp; Motion Graphics):


	Edit raw footage into polished final videos using industry-standard software (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, etc.).
	Create and integrate graphics, motion graphics, and animations for video projects.
	Design visual assets (thumbnails, social media banners, video intros/outros).
	Optimize videos for multiple platforms (social media, web, events, etc.).
	Ensure all outputs meet brand guidelines and deadlines.


Quality Control &amp; Delivery:


	Review and revise videos and designs based on feedback.
	Maintain organized video files, design assets, and an accessible media archive.


Qualifications &amp; Skills


	Proven experience as a videographer, video editor, and graphics designer (portfolio required).
	Proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve) and design tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva).
	Strong knowledge of lighting, sound, cinematography, and visual storytelling principles.
	Ability to produce motion graphics and animated content.
	Creativity, storytelling skills, and a keen eye for aesthetics.
	Excellent time-management skills to handle multiple projects simultaneously.


Preferred:


	Experience producing short-form video for social media (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts).
	Photography skills (bonus).
	Knowledge of branding and visual identity design.


Method of Application

Production Manager Job at Avalon Outsourcing.




        
    

        
        Avalon Hr Solutions is an indigeniuos organization based on Recruitment and Employee Training.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Production Manager 

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Plan, organize, and manage daily production operations to meet output and quality targets.
	Develop and implement production schedules, ensuring optimal use of manpower, materials, and equipment.
	Lead, mentor, and evaluate production supervisors and staff to foster a high-performance culture.
	Monitor production metrics, analyze performance data, and implement corrective actions when necessary.
	Collaborate with quality assurance, maintenance, and supply chain teams to ensure smooth operations.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including lean manufacturing and waste reduction programs.
	Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations.
	Prepare and manage production budgets, controlling costs while maximizing efficiency.
	Oversee equipment maintenance schedules and coordinate with technical teams to minimize downtime.
	Report regularly to senior management on production performance, challenges, and improvement plans.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree with 3 - 5 years of experience.


Salary
N30,000 - N40,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] or [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Treasury Manager Job at Savannah Energy




        
    

        
        Savannah Energy is a young, high growth, highly ambitious energy company. We are focused on operating in countries where we can make a difference to local communities, where we can play a strategic role in the energy sector and where we can make a positive impact on the socio-economic development of the country.

Our vision is to create a best in class African-focused energy company that we and our stakeholders are proud of. Our five core values of Sustainability, Excellence, Entrepreneurialism, Integrity and Teamwork define the essence of Savannah and underpin our corporate culture.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Treasury Manager 
     

            
    



Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose/Objectives


	To oversee the treasury operations in Nigeria including cash and liquidity management, financial risk mitigation and banking relationships.
	To optimise our Treasury function, supporting our financial objectives and business growth.


Duties & Responsibilities


	Key member of the Head of Finance leadership team and interfacing with different disciplines across the business.
	Responsible for the company’s treasury operations and provides advice on international financing issues related to acquisitions, new ventures and divestitures.
	Monitor local debt / bonds facilities and associated reporting requirements to ensure full compliance.
	Develop and maintain healthy and productive relationships with banks and other funding sources to secure the most favourable terms for the business.
	Conduct risk assessments related to foreign exchange, interest rates, and commodity pricing.
	Proactively manage cash flow forecasting and liquidity management to ensure sufficient funds for operational needs.
	Develop strategies for optimising working capital, including receivables and payables management.
	Ensure all treasury activities comply with CBN regulations, FIRS requirements, and company policy.
	Maintain awareness of changes in financial regulations and proactively adjust operations accordingly.
	Prepare periodic treasury reports and present to Head of Finance.
	Support the Head of Finance on achieving Finance objectives.


Job & Main Specifications (Education/Knowledge, Skills, Attributes, Experience & Other Required Details)


	University Degree in Accounting or any Finance related discipline.
	Minimum of 15 years of experience within a treasury function, out of which 5 years must be in a leadership role, preferably with an upstream Oil and Gas operator.
	Relevant postgraduate/professional qualifications (ICAN, ACA, ACCA, CIMA etc.).
	Strong relationship, interpersonal and communication skills.
	Able to build and leverage strong relationships with the various banks and lenders alike to the benefit of the Company.
	Experience of debt refinancing and debt covenant reporting.
	Vast understanding of capital planning, optimising financial resources and maintaining strong liquidity
	and short-term cash flow forecasting.
	Strong analytical, business acumen, leadership, negotiation and persuading skills.
	Results oriented with high level of attention to details.
	Strong business ethics and high level of integrity.
	Able to lead and build a high performing team.
	Ability to work efficiently under pressure.
	Be willing to live our values and have a passion for "Projects that Matter".

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Full Stack Engineer",
  "description": "Source Microfinance Bank is a digital bank with a focus on how to serve you better always! At Source Credit, we have our plans to serve you better right at the center of all we do, and our service offerings. We also ensure we give the best customer service experience that is tailored just for you. Source Microfinance Bank is poised to change the face of banking in Nigeria. We are reinventing banking to empower a generation.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Full Stack Engineer&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview


	As a Full Stack Engineer at our bank, you will work with cross-functional teams to design,&nbsp; implement, and optimize both frontend and backend systems using React and NestJS as the&nbsp;&nbsp;primary frameworks.
	You will also ensure the quality, performance, and security of our web&nbsp; solutions, as well as troubleshoot and support production issues.
	You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and learn from industry experts.


Role Description


	Implement frontend user interfaces using ReactJS and other web technologies.&nbsp;
	Ensure responsiveness, usability, and accessibility across different devices and&nbsp; browsers.&nbsp;&nbsp;
	Implement backend services, APIs, and data integration layers using NestJS as the primary framework.
	Ensure efficiency, reliability, and adherence to industry&nbsp;&nbsp;standards.
	Handle data validation, error handling, and authentication/authorization&nbsp; mechanisms.&nbsp;&nbsp;
	Collaborate with architects and technical leads to define scalable and secure system&nbsp; architecture that aligns with the bank&rsquo;s requirements and industry best practices.&nbsp;&nbsp;

Full Stack Engineer Job at Source Microfinance Bank




        
    

        
        Source Microfinance Bank is a digital bank with a focus on how to serve you better always! At Source Credit, we have our plans to serve you better right at the center of all we do, and our service offerings. We are reinventing banking to empower a generation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Full Stack Engineer 

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview
     

            
    




	As a Full Stack Engineer at our bank, you will work with cross-functional teams to design,  implement, and optimize both frontend and backend systems using React and NestJS as the  primary frameworks.
	You will also ensure the quality, performance, and security of our web  solutions, as well as troubleshoot and support production issues.
	You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and learn from industry experts.


Role Description


	Implement frontend user interfaces using ReactJS and other web technologies. 
	Ensure responsiveness, usability, and accessibility across different devices and  browsers.  
	Implement backend services, APIs, and data integration layers using NestJS as the primary framework.
	Ensure efficiency, reliability, and adherence to industry  standards.
	Handle data validation, error handling, and authentication/authorization  mechanisms.  
	Collaborate with architects and technical leads to define scalable and secure system  architecture that aligns with the bank’s requirements and industry best practices.  
	Design, develop, and maintain web applications that provide banking services to  customers and internal users.  
	?Design and optimize database schemas, write efficient queries, and implement  database access layers for seamless data storage and retrieval.  
	Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
	Conduct unit tests and  contribute to automated testing frameworks to ensure code quality and robustness.  
	Implement security measures and adhere to industry standards and best practices  for data protection, authentication, and authorization.
	Collaborate with security  teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.  
	Investigate and resolve production issues related to backend services and web applications.
	Provide timely support and troubleshooting assistance to resolve  critical incidents.  
	Document system designs, APIs, user interfaces, and implementation details. 
	Contribute to internal knowledge sharing platforms and participate in code reviews  to maintain code quality and foster a collaborative development environment. 


Qualifications


	Proven experience as a Full Stack Engineer or similar role, preferably within the  banking or financial industry.  
	Strong proficiency in front-end development using ReactJS and other web  technologies. Knowledge of Angular is a plus.  
	Strong proficiency in backend development using NestJS. Knowledge of Laravel is a  plus. 
	Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript and knowledge of related libraries and  frameworks.  
	Experience with RESTful API design and development, including authentication and authorization mechanisms.  
	Experience with MongoDB and other NoSQL databases. Knowledge of MySQL is a  plus.  
	Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and Agile software development  methodologies.  
	Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze and debug complex web issues.  
	Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross- functional teams.
